source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Players alternate setting up units, the Defender first; units in **[strategic reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)** are not set up.

- Each time, set up 1 unit wholly within your deployment zone.
- Setting up a **TITANIC** unit costs you your next set-up turn.
- Once one player has finished, the other sets up all their remaining units.

detail.finish: the other side sets up all units still due to deploy
